grid_accepted.reason: The script compares the amount with JavaScript <=, which reads null, blank text, true, false and a one item list as the numbers 0, 1 or the item, and lets the lead go on. The node judges only a number or numeric text and rejects anything else as loan amount exceeds maximum: a lead with no amount we can read is not priced.
